metadata.demo_name: Robotaxi Rain Mode - Houhai/Coastal City Demo Data Pack
metadata.disclaimer: This demo data pack illustrates product logic. It does not represent official Robotaxi PUDO, legal rules, ODD, vehicle supply, or real ETA.

scenario.operation_notice_en: Rain may reduce vehicle availability. Waiting time may be longer than usual.
scenario.operation_notice_zh: 受降雨影响，车辆供给可能减少，等待时间可能延长。
scenario.fallback_suggestion_en: You may continue waiting, choose another valid pickup option, or switch to another transport mode.
scenario.fallback_suggestion_zh: 你可以继续等待、选择其他合法上车点，或切换其他出行方式。

legal_rules_summary.description: Candidate must be inside simulated Robotaxi service/ODD boundary.
Candidate must be assumed legal for stopping in this demo.
Candidate must be reachable by vehicle without unsafe or blocked approach.
In production, exclude bus-only, fire hydrant, crosswalk, no-stopping, red-curb, or emergency access locations. Demo uses assumed filtering.
Candidate should not force unsafe boarding or road crossing under rain.
If rain exceeds ODD, show service limitation instead of PUDO recommendation.
